lines.en: I fly through the ghost oak wood

lines.zh: 我的眼睛白得没有瞳孔
lines.en: My eyes are white, without pupils
I skim along the trunks
One tree shadow and I vanish
I fly straight, I do not curve
The leaves close behind me
I cut across between two trees
The mist in the air follows me
No shadow of mine falls below

lines.zh: 我的翅膀泛着诡异的白。
lines.en: My wings are a strange white.
My call is very short
I head deep into the wood
I pass around a hanging vine
My white eyes flash between leaves
Two beats and I rise
I spiral up the trunk
I hang upside down from a ghost oak
The trunk is pale gray
I neither move nor call
There is no wind sound in this wood

lines.zh: 我展开翅膀，灰落了一地。
lines.en: I spread my wings and ash falls.
Something passed below

lines.zh: 我睁着眼，从入夜到天亮。
lines.en: My eyes stay open from dusk to dawn.
The trees here are not quite right
I am listening to your steps
My wings are gray
I hang very steadily

lines.zh: 幽魂橡木林里，只来我一只。
lines.en: In the haunted oak wood I come alone.
Three loops and you're still here.
My eyes make you uncomfortable
This wood is not yours
I have been in the trees all along

lines.zh: 你看见我的时候就晚了
lines.en: Seeing me means it is too late

lines.zh: 你盯我多久，我就盯你多久。
lines.en: As long as you stare, I stare back.

lines.zh: 你的手电照不到我这里
lines.en: Your torch does not reach me here
You may have heard my name
The white dots in the trees are all me
You looked up, and our eyes met
I flew off at once

lines.zh: 我的翅膀缺了一角，眼睛还睁着。
lines.en: A corner of my wing is gone; my eyes are still open.
I land on a branch
That hurt
My eyes are still open

lines.zh: 我的眼睛暗了一下，又亮。
lines.en: My eyes dim once, then brighten.
I stay still on the tree
This wound heals fast
I hide higher up
I remember you

lines.zh: 糖太甜，我只闻出你的怕。
lines.en: The candy is too sweet; I only smell your fear.
I know what you hold
Candy? I do not need it

lines.zh: 你可以留着可疑的东西
lines.en: You may keep the suspicious thing
Candy will not buy my gaze
I sniff it, it is sweet
I will not eat it, nor take it

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，树会记住
lines.en: Set it down, the trees will remember
There is better food in this wood
I will not trade with you
You hit my wing
I am light, and you did not back off
My wings are cold
That knocked a leaf loose

lines.zh: 我从幽魂橡木林飞过，眼睛白得没有瞳孔。
lines.en: I fly the ghost oak wood, eyes white and pupil-less.
Your shoulder went cold
I went around you

lines.zh: 你的鼻尖碰到我的凉气。
lines.en: Your nose meets my cold air.
You shivered, I know
There is a mark on the tree now

lines.zh: 幽魂橡木林里同类不多
lines.en: Few of us in the ghost oak wood
When kin meet, our eyes are both white
We hang from the same branch
Neither makes a sound
Two together make the wood colder
It flew off, I did not follow

lines.zh: 这里的树够我们各挂一只
lines.en: Enough trees for one of us each
We do not converse
We watch those who pass below
After a while it left
I hook it with a claw
This thing is sweet
I hang it on a branch
I keep the candy, not the wrapper
It is stuck in the bark
I carried it a short way

lines.zh: 掉在林子里的东西我先看到
lines.en: I see things dropped in the wood first
This is not worth carrying
I leave it in the fork
Someone will come for it
There is a person in the wood

lines.zh: 我在上面看了你一会儿
lines.en: I have watched you from above a while
You carry light, very conspicuous
These trees are mine

lines.zh: 我慢慢往下降，橡木林在下面。
lines.en: I descend slowly; the oak grove lies below.
You are still heading deeper

lines.zh: 叶子上的白点都朝你转
lines.en: Every white dot on the leaves turns to you
I wait for you to reach that old tree

lines.zh: 我从树冠松开爪子，落下。
lines.en: I let go of the canopy and fall.
Starting from this tree
I stay above you

lines.zh: 你跑一步，我只需挪半寸。
lines.en: You run a step; I move half an inch.
The mist helps me
Each step you take, I come closer

lines.zh: 每条岔路，最后都通向我。
lines.en: Every fork ends at me.

lines.zh: 我落在你前面那棵树上
lines.en: I land on the tree ahead of you
My eyes stay pointed down
You will see nothing if you turn
The fog is thicker; even the trees blur.
You are deep in the wood now

lines.zh: 我从高枝坠下，翅膀收着。
lines.en: I drop from a high branch, wings folded.
My claws are thin and sharp
That landed on your shoulder

lines.zh: 我在你肩上留下两个白点。
lines.en: I leave two white marks on your shoulder.
You felt a chill
I take flight again at once
That left no wound
Your hand comes up too slowly
I circle back to the tree
Even looking up you will not see me

lines.zh: 我从幽魂橡木的影子里出来
lines.en: I come out of a ghost oak's shadow
One more on this tree
I settle high up first
The mist in the wood thickened

lines.zh: 我的白眼睛先于身体出现。
lines.en: My white eyes appear before my body.

lines.zh: 我挂下来，慢慢展开翅膀
lines.en: I hang down and slowly spread my wings

lines.zh: 这片林子今晚只有你我。
lines.en: Tonight this forest holds only you and me.
My wings brush the leaves

lines.zh: 静得能听见你踩断树枝。
lines.en: It's quiet enough to hear you snap a twig.
I fly toward the light

lines.zh: 火光让我的影子露出来了
lines.en: The firelight exposed my shadow

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，翅膀翻了
lines.en: I fall from above, wings flailing

lines.zh: 水没过翅膀，白眼睛还亮着。
lines.en: Water covers my wings, but my white eyes still glow.

lines.zh: 爆炸的亮光把林子照穿了
lines.en: The blast lit through the whole wood

lines.zh: 飞来的东西穿过了我的翼
lines.en: Something flying went through my wing
That force pressed me to a tree
I am not quite hungry, only slower

lines.zh: 雷劈在幽魂橡木上，白得刺眼
lines.en: Lightning struck a ghost oak, blindingly white
There are no trees to hang from in the void
